_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, net-to-gross, expense, receivables and operating-margin signals with Visa's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that enables innovative, secure and reliable electronic payments across more than 200 countries and territories.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (this one no longer has the earlier 10-Ks' sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa

theme_watch.reason: Live: Visa's own FY2020 10-K says 'The global payments industry is undergoing significant and rapid technological change, including mobile and other proximity and in-app payment technologies, ecommerce, tokenization, cryptocurrencies, distributed ledger and blockchain technologies, and new authentication technologies such as biometrics, 3D Secure 2.0 and dynamic cardholder verification values or dCVV2.' The stock trades at 48.8x FY21E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of Visa's network specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that enables innovative, secure and reliable electronic payments across more than 200 countries and territories.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (this one no longer has the earlier 10-Ks' sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +122% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.55; conservative 2yr -48%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.1%/yr (worst year FY11-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +0.6%/yr (Q2 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.4%/yr (FY11-FY20 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY20, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: V (retrospective, 2021-07-09) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (68.0% downside to Bear $76.23 / -17.6% upside to Bull $196.61) | Adj composite 1.20 vs market 3.75: gap -2.55 [OVERVALUED] | +122% above the EPP floor $107.58 (22x FY21E $4.89) | Conservative 2-yr case: -47.6% total (-23.8%/yr) | At 48.8x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $315.38 sits above the BULL case; revenue -2.1% YoY in Q2 FY21, forward revenues -2.1% (Q2 FY21 revenue growth (no FY21 revenue range)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
